title: CTA / ask calibration

questions.text: Is the size/type of ask appropriate for the state of this relationship?

inputs: the ask in the candidate message

criteria.text: the ask does not escalate beyond what the buyer signalled
criteria.guide: Compare the strength of the ask (none, light, specific, closing) with the buyer's latest signal.

criteria.text: the ask is the next reasonable step for the stage
criteria.guide: A contract or signature ask when technical validation is the next step is too strong.

criteria.text: a clear ask exists where an agreed next step or explicit commitment exists
criteria.guide: A vague CTA, or none, despite an agreed next step or explicit commitment is too weak.

criteria.text: the buyer is not asked to do several things at once
criteria.guide: Several parallel asks in one message dilute the step and count as too strong.

failure_examples: asking for contract signature when next reasonable step is technical validation
vague CTA when a clear agreed next step exists
no CTA despite an explicit commitment
asking the buyer to do multiple things at once
escalating commitment beyond what the buyer signaled
principles: Separate from timing: judge the size/type of the ask, not when it is sent (§5.2).

labels.label: TOO_WEAK
labels.when: ask_strength = too_weak: the ask is vaguer or softer than the agreed step or commitment requires.

labels.label: APPROPRIATE
labels.when: ask_strength = appropriate for the state of this relationship.

labels.label: TOO_STRONG
labels.when: ask_strength = too_strong: the ask escalates beyond what the buyer signalled.

diagnostics.name: ask_too_strong
diagnostics.when: the ask escalates beyond the buyer's signal

diagnostics.name: ask_too_weak
diagnostics.when: the ask is vaguer than the agreed step or commitment
